# Requests by Colart

> A directory of karaoke bars and entertainment venues hosted by Colart Digital Marketing Agency. Each venue has its own branded page where guests submit song requests that are sent straight to the venue over WhatsApp — no app required.

Requests by Colart (requests.colartdigitalmarketingagency.com) lists Colart's karaoke and entertainment venue partners as searchable, filterable cards. Opening a venue's card goes to its own dedicated request page.

## Venues

- [Tune Karaoke](https://requests.colartdigitalmarketingagency.com/tunekaraoke): Mobile karaoke experience bringing music, fun and entertainment to pubs, cafés, private parties, birthdays and events. Requests sent via WhatsApp.
- [Joe's Bar — Batroun](https://requests.colartdigitalmarketingagency.com/joesbarbatroun): Batroun's karaoke bar for over 20 years. Guests pick a host and their request is sent to that host directly on WhatsApp.

- [Colart Digital Marketing Agency](https://colartdigitalmarketingagency.com): Branding and digital marketing agency serving Lebanon, the GCC and beyond.
- [Colart's Services](https://colartdigitalmarketingagency.com/services)

- [Menus by Colart](https://menus.colartdigitalmarketingagency.com): Digital menu hosting — a venue's menu designed, hosted and kept up to date at its own web address.
